tagline: spotDL finds songs from Spotify playlists on YouTube and downloads them - along with album art, lyrics and metadata.
description: spotDL finds songs from Spotify playlists on YouTube and downloads them - along with album art, lyrics and metadata.

tips.before_install: The default download location is set to `/DATA/Media/Music`. You can change this by going into the app settings and changing the specified path.
